recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Revisit only if the work group wants a new policy discussion about raw-resource POST bodies for operations that declare more than one Resource input parameter; that is beyond FHIR-12070 and FHIR-28620.
issue_request: FHIR-12070 asked to clarify that the operation POST-body shortcut applies when the only parameter in a specific invocation is a resource, not merely when the operation definition declares only one parameter.
initial_application: Jira comments record application in svn @10160. No current Git commit mentions FHIR-12070 directly; the original ambiguous sentence is no longer present in current source and the active wording was later replaced by FHIR-28620 commit 1f6ffabb3d.
additional_context: FHIR-28620 is a later Published/Persuasive clarification for the same shortcut, allowing a POST body to carry the single Resource input while additional simple submitted parameters are carried as query parameters. The current source says this applies to all other parameters a client intends to submit, which resolves the FHIR-12070 declared-vs-actual ambiguity while preserving the later exactly-one-Resource-input condition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/operations.html wording already distinguishes invocation-time submitted parameters from operation-definition parameters and is more precise than the older example wording.
